svg.title: Three future repairs: joint counts and replacement risk
svg.desc: Left: all ten count vectors in resolved, revisit, replacement order, with Dirichlet-multinomial probabilities from posterior (7, 4, 1). The most likely vector is (2, 1, 0), probability 4/13. Right: replacement counts 0 to 3 under shared uncertainty and a plug-in binomial. Shared probabilities are 11/14, 33/182, 11/364, 1/364. At least one replacement has probability 3/14; the plug-in value is 397/1728. Labels, outlines and hatching distinguish models.
